mechanics.original_reminder: If you don't control an autocrat, put X +1/+1 counters on this. It becomes an autocrat until it has no +1/+1 counters on it.
mechanics.executable_reminder: If you don't control a permanent with the autocrat status, put {Number} +1/+1 counters on this creature. Give this creature the autocrat status until it has no +1/+1 counters.

rule_text.name: 701.99a
rule_text.rule: “Autocrat N” means “If you don’t control an autocrat, put X +1/+1 counters on this. It becomes an autocrat until it has no +1/+1 counters on it.”

rule_text.name: 701.99b
rule_text.rule: “An autocrat” is a designation that has no rules meaning other than to act as a marker that the autocrat action and other spells and abilities can identify. Only permanents can be or become an autocrat. Once a permanent becomes an autocrat, it stays an autocrat until it leaves the battlefield or has no +1/+1 counters on it. Being an autocrat is neither an ability nor part of the permanent’s copiable values.

rule_text.name: 701.99c
rule_text.rule: If a permanent’s ability instructs a player to “autocrat X,” other abilities of that permanent may also refer to X. The value of X in those abilities is equal to the value of X as that permanent became an autocrat.
